Failure feedback hai, defeat nahi.
Character destiny banata.
"Hamesha zyada time lagta—jitna expect karte."
Aaj ka effort kal ka advantage ban jata hai.
Jeetna sab kuch nahi, par jeetne ki chah zaroori hai.
Motivation jeet leti hai, jab talent kaam nahi karta.
Apne darr se mat dabo.
Khud ke saath sabr rakho. Khud ka vikas nazuk hota hai.
Impossible ko possible maan lo, ho jayega.
"Make it work, make it right, make it fast."
Jo tum daily karte ho, wo once-in-a-while se zyada matters.
Perfection nahi—progress ka strive.
